integrity: Analytic martingale proof, independent exponential-pause Poisson-equation comparison, and replayable symbolic/trajectory checks are included.
scientific_limitations: Independent iid Brownian/exponential cycles and positive iid refractory periods with finite fourth moment; exact for \(0<a<1\). Determines only refractory variance, not its entire law. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof.
title: Refractory-time variance is identifiable through integrated fluctuations under partial Brownian resetting
